<description>
There seems to be consensus in #36759 to use `LogWarnThenDebug` when the Tor control port can't be reached as this makes such cases much less noisy. This pull aligns SOCKS5 proxies (`-proxy`, `-onion`) and the I2P SAM proxy (`-i2psam`) with that, making them also less noisy.

Until now every failed attempt logged the `connect()` failure at info level, and I2P additionally logged "Couldn't listen" as an error. Now the first failure is logged as a warning and later ones only at debug level.
</description>

<commits>
5146f7f60f i2p: Warn only once when the SAM proxy is unreachable or listening fails

058e26fddd netbase: Warn only once when a proxy is unreachable
</commits>

diff --git a/src/i2p.cpp b/src/i2p.cpp
index 42e7cf647a..202f2e7dd0 100644
--- a/src/i2p.cpp
+++ b/src/i2p.cpp
@@ -149,7 +149,7 @@ bool Session::Listen(Connection& conn)
         conn.sock = StreamAccept();
         return true;
     } catch (const std::runtime_error& e) {
-        LogError("Couldn't listen: %s\n", e.what());
+        LogWarnThenDebug(BCLog::I2P, "i2p: Couldn't listen: %s", e.what());
         CheckControlSock();
     }
     return false;
@@ -331,6 +331,7 @@ std::unique_ptr<Sock> Session::Hello() const
     auto sock = m_control_host.Connect();
 
     if (!sock) {
+        LogWarnThenDebug(BCLog::I2P, "i2p: Cannot connect to SAM proxy %s", m_control_host.ToString());
         throw std::runtime_error(strprintf("Cannot connect to %s", m_control_host.ToString()));
     }

+    if (!m_is_unix_socket) return ConnectDirectly(proxy, /*manual_connection=*/false);
 
 #ifdef HAVE_SOCKADDR_UN
     auto sock = CreateSock(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
@@ -704,7 +704,7 @@ std::unique_ptr<Sock> Proxy::Connect() const
                          (struct sockaddr*)&addrun,
                          len,
                          path,
-                         /*manual_connection=*/true,
+                         /*manual_connection=*/false,
                          std::chrono::milliseconds{nConnectTimeout})) {
         return {};
     }
@@ -810,6 +810,7 @@ std::unique_ptr<Sock> ConnectThroughProxy(const Proxy& proxy,
     // first connect to proxy server
     auto sock = proxy.Connect();
     if (!sock) {
+        LogWarnThenDebug(BCLog::PROXY, "Cannot connect to proxy %s", proxy.ToString());
         proxy_connection_failed = true;
         return {};
     }
